name: Yahoo Finance (unofficial)
tagline: Unofficial market data endpoints used by Yahoo Finance clients
description: Community-documented, unofficial Yahoo Finance query endpoints for quotes, charts, fundamentals, and related market data. Not an officially supported public product; endpoints, auth cookies, and rate limits can change without notice.

auth.details: No official API key. Many endpoints work unauthenticated; some scrapers use session cookies from finance.yahoo.com. Subject to change.

use_cases: get current stock quote for a ticker
